answer_1.quote: We evaluate DeepResonance on three conventional music understanding tasks (i.e., music + text (instruction)-→ text) and three multimodal music understanding tasks (i.e., music + image/video + text (instruction) -→ text (multimodal-enriched)).
answer_1.outputs: textual descriptions enriched with multimodal information, such as music, images/videos, and low-level music features, including tempo, chords, key, and downbeats
